Match the supplied Let's Go Begin textbook style: bright 2D children's cartoon, clean bold dark outlines, soft shading, cheerful colors, white or very pale background, whole rabbit fully visible including ears, paws, body, and tail, centered with generous safe margins. No other animals, no badges, no numbers, no labels, no words, no speech bubbles, no watermark, no cropped edges.

Show the entire cow centered with generous safe margins: both complete ears, full head, complete four legs and hooves, full tail, no part cut by the frame. The cow should be standing naturally and clearly recognizable. No other animals, no partial objects, no badges, no numbers, no labels, no words, no speech bubbles, no watermark, no cropped edges, no border.

Keep the duck large and crisp enough for a small learner card. No other animals, no partial objects, no watermarks, no badges, no numbers, no labels, no words, no speech bubbles, no cropped edges, no border.
